items.question: Trong câu "The most common misconception about agile:", từ "misconception" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The most common misconception about agile:", what does "misconception" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: misconception /ˌmɪs.kənˈsep.ʃən/ (danh từ): quan niệm sai lầm. Cụm hay gặp: "a common misconception about X" = một hiểu lầm phổ biến về X.
items.explanationEn: misconception /ˌmɪs.kənˈsep.ʃən/ (noun): a wrong belief or idea. A common pattern is "a common misconception about X", meaning a widely held wrong idea about X.

items.question: Trong câu "This is flatly wrong.", từ "flatly" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "This is flatly wrong.", what does "flatly" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: flatly /ˈflæt.li/ (trạng từ): hoàn toàn, dứt khoát. "Flatly wrong / flatly refuse" nhấn mạnh mức độ tuyệt đối; nghĩa khác là nói giọng đều đều, vô cảm.
items.explanationEn: flatly /ˈflæt.li/ (adverb): completely, absolutely. "Flatly wrong" or "flatly refuse" stresses that something is total; another sense is speaking in a dull, even tone.

items.question: Trong câu "Agile does not eliminate requirements — it changes how you discover, record, and manage them.", từ "eliminate" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Agile does not eliminate requirements — it changes how you discover, record, and manage them.", what does "eliminate" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: eliminate /iˈlɪm.ɪ.neɪt/ (động từ): loại bỏ hoàn toàn. "Eliminate waste / risk / the need for X" là các cụm rất phổ biến trong tài liệu kỹ thuật.
items.explanationEn: eliminate /iˈlɪm.ɪ.neɪt/ (verb): to remove completely. Common collocations are "eliminate waste", "eliminate risk" and "eliminate the need for X".

items.question: Trong câu "No method excuses you from understanding why the project exists and what value it must create.", từ "excuse" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "No method excuses you from understanding why the project exists and what value it must create.", what does "excuse" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to free someone from a duty
items.explanation: excuse /ɪkˈskjuːz/ (động từ): miễn cho (khỏi việc gì). "Excuse somebody from doing something" = miễn cho ai khỏi phải làm gì; nghĩa khác là tha thứ.
items.explanationEn: excuse /ɪkˈskjuːz/ (verb): to free someone from a duty. "Excuse somebody from doing something" means releasing them from that duty; another sense is to forgive.

items.question: Trong câu "Agile defers detail, but does not eliminate it.", từ "defer" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Agile defers detail, but does not eliminate it.", what does "defer" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: defer /dɪˈfɜːr/ (động từ): hoãn lại, để sau. "Defer a decision / defer detail" = hoãn quyết định, để chi tiết đến lúc cần; cũng có "defer to someone" = nhường ý kiến ai.
items.explanationEn: defer /dɪˈfɜːr/ (verb): to postpone until later. "Defer a decision" means postponing it; "defer to someone" is a different sense: to accept their judgement.

items.question: Trong câu "They do not vanish just because you wrote the requirement on a card.", từ "vanish" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "They do not vanish just because you wrote the requirement on a card.", what does "vanish" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: vanish /ˈvæn.ɪʃ/ (động từ): biến mất. "Vanish" thường đi với "completely / without trace"; ở đây ý là các ràng buộc không tự biến mất.
items.explanationEn: vanish /ˈvæn.ɪʃ/ (verb): to disappear. It often appears as "vanish completely" or "vanish without trace"; here constraints do not simply disappear.

items.question: Trong câu "The overarching principle — and it applies to EVERY project, not just agile: accumulate shared understanding GOOD ENOUGH to build the next portion of the product at an acceptable level of risk.", từ "overarching" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The overarching principle — and it applies to EVERY project, not just agile: accumulate shared understanding GOOD ENOUGH to build the next portion of the product at an acceptable level of risk.", what does "overarching" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: overarching /ˌəʊ.vəˈrɑː.tʃɪŋ/ (tính từ): bao trùm, chung nhất. "Overarching goal / principle / theme" = mục tiêu, nguyên tắc bao trùm mọi thứ khác.
items.explanationEn: overarching /ˌəʊ.vəˈrɑː.tʃɪŋ/ (adjective): covering everything, general. Typical collocations are "overarching goal", "overarching principle" and "overarching theme".

items.question: Trong câu "The product owner is the person with the authority to decide the content and ordering of the product backlog.", từ "authority" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The product owner is the person with the authority to decide the content and ordering of the product backlog.", what does "authority" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: authority /ɔːˈθɒr.ə.ti/ (danh từ): quyền hạn, thẩm quyền. "Have the authority to do something" = có thẩm quyền làm gì; "an authority on X" lại là chuyên gia về X.
items.explanationEn: authority /ɔːˈθɒr.ə.ti/ (noun): the power to make decisions. "Have the authority to do something" means having the power to do it; "an authority on X" is an expert.

items.question: Trong câu "They must escalate every decision, blocking the team constantly.", từ "escalate" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "They must escalate every decision, blocking the team constantly.", what does "escalate" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to pass up to a higher level
items.explanation: escalate /ˈes.kə.leɪt/ (động từ): chuyển lên cấp cao hơn. "Escalate an issue to management" = chuyển vấn đề lên cấp quản lý; nghĩa khác là leo thang (xung đột).
items.explanationEn: escalate /ˈes.kə.leɪt/ (verb): to pass up to a higher level. "Escalate an issue to management" means passing it upward; another sense is a conflict growing more intense.

items.question: Trong câu "The team receives contradictory requirements and nobody is accountable.", từ "contradictory" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The team receives contradictory requirements and nobody is accountable.", what does "contradictory" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: contradictory /ˌkɒn.trəˈdɪk.tər.i/ (tính từ): mâu thuẫn nhau. "Contradictory requirements / evidence" = yêu cầu, bằng chứng mâu thuẫn; động từ là "contradict".
items.explanationEn: contradictory /ˌkɒn.trəˈdɪk.tər.i/ (adjective): conflicting with each other. Common phrases are "contradictory requirements" and "contradictory evidence"; the verb is "contradict".

items.question: Trong câu "On a complex system with many stakeholders, many integrations, and many regulations, a dedicated BA makes an enormous difference.", từ "dedicated" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "On a complex system with many stakeholders, many integrations, and many regulations, a dedicated BA makes an enormous difference.", what does "dedicated" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: dedicated /ˈded.ɪ.keɪ.tɪd/ (tính từ): chuyên trách. "A dedicated BA / server" = người, máy chủ dành riêng cho một việc; nghĩa khác là tận tụy.
items.explanationEn: dedicated /ˈded.ɪ.keɪ.tɪd/ (adjective): assigned only to one task. "A dedicated BA" or "a dedicated server" is used only for one purpose; another sense is devoted or committed.

items.question: Trong câu "Maintains the holistic view while the team focuses on individual stories: how does this story fit the overall workflow?", từ "holistic" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Maintains the holistic view while the team focuses on individual stories: how does this story fit the overall workflow?", what does "holistic" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: holistic /həʊˈlɪs.tɪk/ (tính từ): tổng thể, toàn diện. "A holistic view / approach" = cách nhìn, cách tiếp cận tổng thể thay vì từng mảnh rời rạc.
items.explanationEn: holistic /həʊˈlɪs.tɪk/ (adjective): seeing the whole together. "A holistic view" or "a holistic approach" looks at the whole system rather than isolated parts.

items.question: Trong câu "When a team works story by story, iteration by iteration, it is very easy to lose sight of the whole — the end-to-end workflow, the dependencies, the gaps.", từ "lose sight of" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "When a team works story by story, iteration by iteration, it is very easy to lose sight of the whole — the end-to-end workflow, the dependencies, the gaps.", what does "lose sight of" (phrase) mean?
options: quên mất, không còn chú ý tới
items.explanation: lose sight of /luːz saɪt əv/ (cụm từ): quên mất, không còn chú ý tới. "Lose sight of the goal / the big picture" = quên mất mục tiêu, bức tranh tổng thể.
items.explanationEn: lose sight of /luːz saɪt əv/ (phrase): to stop paying attention to. It is often used as "lose sight of the goal" or "lose sight of the big picture".

items.question: Trong câu "Elicits quality attributes and business rules — the things most easily missed in agile.", từ "elicit" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Elicits quality attributes and business rules — the things most easily missed in agile.", what does "elicit" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: elicit /iˈlɪs.ɪt/ (động từ): khai thác, gợi ra. "Elicit requirements / information from stakeholders" = khai thác yêu cầu từ các bên liên quan.
items.explanationEn: elicit /iˈlɪs.ɪt/ (verb): to draw out information. A core BA collocation is "elicit requirements from stakeholders".

items.question: Trong câu "It evolves continuously.", từ "evolve" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "It evolves continuously.", what does "evolve" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: evolve /iˈvɒlv/ (động từ): phát triển, thay đổi dần. "Evolve over time" = thay đổi, phát triển dần theo thời gian; danh từ là "evolution".
items.explanationEn: evolve /iˈvɒlv/ (verb): to develop gradually. "Evolve over time" means changing gradually; the noun is "evolution".

items.question: Trong câu "It has UNEVEN detail.", từ "uneven" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "It has UNEVEN detail.", what does "uneven" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: uneven /ʌnˈiː.vən/ (tính từ): không đồng đều. "Uneven detail / quality" = mức chi tiết, chất lượng không đồng đều giữa các phần.
items.explanationEn: uneven /ʌnˈiː.vən/ (adjective): not the same everywhere. "Uneven detail" or "uneven quality" means the level varies from one part to another.

items.question: Trong câu "Items at the BOTTOM: coarse, large, sometimes a single line of description.", từ "coarse" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Items at the BOTTOM: coarse, large, sometimes a single line of description.", what does "coarse" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: coarse /kɔːs/ (tính từ): sơ lược, chưa chi tiết. "Coarse-grained" = mức hạt thô, sơ lược (trái với "fine-grained"); nghĩa khác là thô ráp.
items.explanationEn: coarse /kɔːs/ (adjective): rough, not detailed. "Coarse-grained" is the opposite of "fine-grained"; another sense is rough to the touch.

items.question: Trong câu "This is NOT sloppiness — it is efficiency.", từ "sloppiness" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "This is NOT sloppiness — it is efficiency.", what does "sloppiness" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: sloppiness /ˈslɒp.i.nəs/ (danh từ): sự cẩu thả. Tính từ "sloppy" = cẩu thả, luộm thuộm, ví dụ "sloppy code".
items.explanationEn: sloppiness /ˈslɒp.i.nəs/ (noun): careless, messy work. The adjective is "sloppy", as in "sloppy code".

items.question: Trong câu "Grooming is the ongoing activity of preparing the items at the top of the backlog so they are ready for the next iteration.", từ "ongoing" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Grooming is the ongoing activity of preparing the items at the top of the backlog so they are ready for the next iteration.", what does "ongoing" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: ongoing /ˈɒŋˌɡəʊ.ɪŋ/ (tính từ): liên tục, đang diễn ra. "An ongoing process / effort" = quá trình, nỗ lực diễn ra liên tục chứ không làm một lần.
items.explanationEn: ongoing /ˈɒŋˌɡəʊ.ɪŋ/ (adjective): continuing, still happening. "An ongoing process" or "an ongoing effort" continues over time rather than happening once.

items.question: Trong câu "Clarify vague items by asking the product owner.", từ "vague" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Clarify vague items by asking the product owner.", what does "vague" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: vague /veɪɡ/ (tính từ): mơ hồ, không rõ ràng. "A vague requirement / answer" = yêu cầu, câu trả lời mơ hồ; trái nghĩa là "specific".
items.explanationEn: vague /veɪɡ/ (adjective): unclear, not specific. "A vague requirement" is not specific enough to act on; the opposite is "specific" or "precise".

items.question: Trong câu "instead of accepting a vague story and getting stuck mid-iteration", từ "get stuck" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "instead of accepting a vague story and getting stuck mid-iteration", what does "get stuck" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: get stuck /ɡet stʌk/ (cụm từ): bị kẹt, không tiến được. "Get stuck on a problem" = bị kẹt ở một vấn đề, không làm tiếp được.
items.explanationEn: get stuck /ɡet stʌk/ (phrase): to be unable to progress. "Get stuck on a problem" means you cannot move forward with it.

items.question: Trong câu "The "so that" clause — often skipped but the most important — states the business value.", từ "clause" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The "so that" clause — often skipped but the most important — states the business value.", what does "clause" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: clause /klɔːz/ (danh từ): mệnh đề (trong câu). Ở đây là mệnh đề trong câu; trong pháp lý "clause" là điều khoản, ví dụ "a penalty clause".
items.explanationEn: clause /klɔːz/ (noun): a part of a sentence. Here it is part of a sentence; in legal texts a clause is a contract section, as in "a penalty clause".

items.question: Trong câu "The template is a tool, not dogma.", từ "dogma" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The template is a tool, not dogma.", what does "dogma" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: dogma /ˈdɒɡ.mə/ (danh từ): giáo điều cứng nhắc. Tính từ "dogmatic" = giáo điều; "not dogma" nhấn mạnh có thể linh hoạt khi áp dụng.
items.explanationEn: dogma /ˈdɒɡ.mə/ (noun): a rigid, unquestioned rule. The adjective is "dogmatic"; saying "not dogma" means it can be applied flexibly.

items.question: Trong câu "The goal is clear communication, not format compliance.", từ "compliance" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The goal is clear communication, not format compliance.", what does "compliance" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: compliance /kəmˈplaɪ.əns/ (danh từ): sự tuân thủ. "Compliance with a standard / regulation" = tuân thủ tiêu chuẩn, quy định; động từ "comply with".
items.explanationEn: compliance /kəmˈplaɪ.əns/ (noun): following a rule or standard. It is used as "compliance with a standard"; the verb is "comply with".

items.question: Trong câu "The most important insight about user stories: the card is DELIBERATELY incomplete.", từ "deliberately" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The most important insight about user stories: the card is DELIBERATELY incomplete.", what does "deliberately" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: deliberately /dɪˈlɪb.ər.ət.li/ (trạng từ): cố ý, có chủ đích. "Deliberately incomplete" = cố ý để chưa đầy đủ; nghĩa phụ là (nói, làm) chậm rãi, cân nhắc.
items.explanationEn: deliberately /dɪˈlɪb.ər.ət.li/ (adverb): on purpose. "Deliberately incomplete" means left incomplete on purpose; a secondary sense is slowly and carefully.

items.question: Trong câu "The risk: if the conversation does NOT happen, all you are left with is a useless scrap of paper.", từ "scrap" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The risk: if the conversation does NOT happen, all you are left with is a useless scrap of paper.", what does "scrap" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: scrap /skræp/ (danh từ): mảnh vụn, mẩu nhỏ. "A scrap of paper" = mẩu giấy vụn; "scrap" còn là phế liệu, và động từ "scrap" = hủy bỏ (kế hoạch).
items.explanationEn: scrap /skræp/ (noun): a small leftover piece. "A scrap of paper" is a small piece; "scrap" is also waste metal, and the verb means to abandon a plan.

items.question: Trong câu "Not a fixed contract — the details are negotiated in conversation", từ "negotiate" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Not a fixed contract — the details are negotiated in conversation", what does "negotiate" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: negotiate /nəˈɡəʊ.ʃi.eɪt/ (động từ): thương lượng, bàn bạc. "Negotiate a contract / the details" = thương lượng hợp đồng, chi tiết; tính từ "negotiable".
items.explanationEn: negotiate /nəˈɡəʊ.ʃi.eɪt/ (verb): to discuss to reach agreement. It collocates with "a contract" or "the details"; the adjective is "negotiable".

items.question: Trong câu "Do not force everything into the user story mould.", từ "mould" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Do not force everything into the user story mould.", what does "mould" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: mould /məʊld/ (danh từ): khuôn mẫu. "Force something into a mould" = ép vào một khuôn; "mould" (Anh-Mỹ: mold) còn nghĩa nấm mốc.
items.explanationEn: mould /məʊld/ (noun): a fixed shape or pattern. "Force something into a mould" means squeezing it into one shape; "mould" also means fungus (US "mold").

items.question: Trong câu "The answer is to clarify it or run a spike (a time-boxed investigation) to learn enough.", từ "time-boxed" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The answer is to clarify it or run a spike (a time-boxed investigation) to learn enough.", what does "time-boxed" (adjective) mean?
options: giới hạn thời gian cố định
items.explanation: time-boxed /ˈtaɪm.bɒkst/ (tính từ): giới hạn thời gian cố định. "A time-boxed spike / meeting" = hoạt động bị giới hạn trong một khoảng thời gian định trước.
items.explanationEn: time-boxed /ˈtaɪm.bɒkst/ (adjective): limited to a fixed time. "A time-boxed spike" or "meeting" must end when the agreed time runs out.

items.question: Trong câu "The HORIZONTAL axis: the backbone — the user workflow in chronological order.", từ "chronological" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The HORIZONTAL axis: the backbone — the user workflow in chronological order.", what does "chronological" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: chronological /ˌkrɒn.əˈlɒdʒ.ɪ.kəl/ (tính từ): theo trình tự thời gian. "In chronological order" = theo thứ tự thời gian xảy ra.
items.explanationEn: chronological /ˌkrɒn.əˈlɒdʒ.ɪ.kəl/ (adjective): in time order. The fixed phrase is "in chronological order": in the order events happen.

items.question: Trong câu "Under each backbone activity, you stack the stories that implement it — the most essential at the top, optional refinements below.", từ "stack" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Under each backbone activity, you stack the stories that implement it — the most essential at the top, optional refinements below.", what does "stack" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to push onto a stack structure
items.explanation: stack /stæk/ (động từ): xếp chồng lên nhau. Ở đây là xếp chồng thẻ theo chiều dọc; trong lập trình "stack" là ngăn xếp (cấu trúc dữ liệu).
items.explanationEn: stack /stæk/ (verb): to pile one on another. Here it means piling cards vertically; in programming a stack is a data structure.

items.question: Trong câu "It exposes gaps.", từ "expose" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "It exposes gaps.", what does "expose" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: expose /ɪkˈspəʊz/ (động từ): làm lộ ra, phơi bày. "Expose gaps / problems" = làm lộ ra thiếu sót; trong API "expose an endpoint" = cung cấp ra ngoài.
items.explanationEn: expose /ɪkˈspəʊz/ (verb): to reveal, uncover. "Expose gaps" means revealing them; in APIs "expose an endpoint" means making it available.

items.question: Trong câu "It helps you slice releases meaningfully.", từ "slice" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "It helps you slice releases meaningfully.", what does "slice" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: slice /slaɪs/ (động từ): chia thành phần, cắt lát. "Slice a release / a vertical slice" = chia bản phát hành, lát cắt dọc qua mọi tầng.
items.explanationEn: slice /slaɪs/ (verb): to divide into parts. Related phrases are "slice a release" and "a vertical slice" through all layers.

items.question: Trong câu "Users would rather have a basic way to complete the whole job than one polished step with the rest missing.", từ "polished" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Users would rather have a basic way to complete the whole job than one polished step with the rest missing.", what does "polished" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: polished /ˈpɒl.ɪʃt/ (tính từ): được trau chuốt, hoàn thiện. "A polished product / UI" = sản phẩm được trau chuốt kỹ; nghĩa đen là được đánh bóng.
items.explanationEn: polished /ˈpɒl.ɪʃt/ (adjective): refined and finished. "A polished product" is carefully refined; the literal sense is rubbed until shiny.

items.question: Trong câu "Do not get drawn into terminology arguments.", từ "be drawn into" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Do not get drawn into terminology arguments.", what does "be drawn into" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: be drawn into /biː drɔːn ˈɪn.tuː/ (cụm từ): bị lôi kéo vào. "Get drawn into an argument / a conflict" = bị cuốn vào tranh cãi, xung đột.
items.explanationEn: be drawn into /biː drɔːn ˈɪn.tuː/ (phrase): to get pulled into. It is common as "get drawn into an argument" or "into a conflict".

items.question: Trong câu "A story point is a RELATIVE unit of estimation for the size of a story — it bundles effort, complexity, and uncertainty together.", từ "bundle" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A story point is a RELATIVE unit of estimation for the size of a story — it bundles effort, complexity, and uncertainty together.", what does "bundle" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: bundle /ˈbʌn.dəl/ (động từ): gộp lại với nhau. "Bundle A and B together" = gộp lại; trong web "bundle" còn là gói mã đã đóng gói (bundler).
items.explanationEn: bundle /ˈbʌn.dəl/ (verb): to group together. "Bundle A and B together" means combining them; in web development a bundle is packaged code.

items.question: Trong câu "People estimate relative size far better than absolute duration.", từ "absolute" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "People estimate relative size far better than absolute duration.", what does "absolute" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: absolute /ˈæb.sə.luːt/ (tính từ): tuyệt đối (không so sánh). "Absolute vs. relative" = tuyệt đối và tương đối; "absolute" còn nghĩa hoàn toàn, ví dụ "absolute trust".
items.explanationEn: absolute /ˈæb.sə.luːt/ (adjective): measured on its own. It contrasts with "relative"; it can also mean total, as in "absolute trust".

items.question: Trong câu "A consensus estimation technique in which each person picks a number PRIVATELY, and everyone reveals simultaneously.", từ "consensus" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A consensus estimation technique in which each person picks a number PRIVATELY, and everyone reveals simultaneously.", what does "consensus" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: consensus /kənˈsen.səs/ (danh từ): sự đồng thuận. "Reach a consensus" = đạt được sự đồng thuận của cả nhóm.
items.explanationEn: consensus /kənˈsen.səs/ (noun): general agreement. The common phrase is "reach a consensus" among the group.

items.question: Trong câu "Why private-then-simultaneous matters: it prevents anchoring.", từ "anchoring" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Why private-then-simultaneous matters: it prevents anchoring.", what does "anchoring" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: bias from the first number heard
items.explanation: anchoring /ˈæŋ.kər.ɪŋ/ (danh từ): thiên kiến mỏ neo. "Anchoring bias" = thiên kiến mỏ neo: con số nghe đầu tiên kéo các ước tính khác theo nó.
items.explanationEn: anchoring /ˈæŋ.kər.ɪŋ/ (noun): bias from the first number heard. "Anchoring bias" means the first number heard pulls other estimates toward it.

items.question: Trong câu "everyone converges on 3 even if they thought otherwise", từ "converge" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "everyone converges on 3 even if they thought otherwise", what does "converge" (verb) mean?
options: hội tụ, dồn về một điểm
optionsEn: to come together on one point
items.explanation: converge /kənˈvɜːdʒ/ (động từ): hội tụ, dồn về một điểm. "Converge on a value" = dồn về cùng một giá trị; trái nghĩa là "diverge".
items.explanationEn: converge /kənˈvɜːdʒ/ (verb): to come together on one point. "Converge on a value" means coming to the same point; the opposite is "diverge".

items.question: Trong câu "the team will simply inflate their estimates", từ "inflate" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "the team will simply inflate their estimates", what does "inflate" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: inflate /ɪnˈfleɪt/ (động từ): thổi phồng (con số). "Inflate estimates / figures" = thổi phồng con số; nghĩa đen là bơm căng (bóng, lốp).
items.explanationEn: inflate /ɪnˈfleɪt/ (verb): to make a number bigger. "Inflate estimates" means artificially raising them; the literal sense is filling with air.

items.question: Trong câu "A new team needs several iterations for velocity to stabilise.", từ "stabilise" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A new team needs several iterations for velocity to stabilise.", what does "stabilise" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: stabilise /ˈsteɪ.bəl.aɪz/ (động từ): ổn định lại. Cách viết Anh-Mỹ là "stabilize"; danh từ "stability" = sự ổn định.
items.explanationEn: stabilise /ˈsteɪ.bəl.aɪz/ (verb): to become steady. The American spelling is "stabilize"; the noun is "stability".

items.question: Trong câu "Present forecasts as a RANGE based on the lowest and highest observed velocity, not as a single number.", từ "forecast" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Present forecasts as a RANGE based on the lowest and highest observed velocity, not as a single number.", what does "forecast" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: forecast /ˈfɔː.kɑːst/ (danh từ): dự báo, dự đoán. "A forecast" khác "a commitment": dự báo có độ không chắc chắn, còn cam kết là lời hứa.
items.explanationEn: forecast /ˈfɔː.kɑːst/ (noun): a prediction of the future. A forecast differs from a commitment: it carries uncertainty rather than being a promise.

items.question: Trong câu "Written in business language, not technical jargon.", từ "jargon" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Written in business language, not technical jargon.", what does "jargon" (noun) mean?
options: thuật ngữ chuyên ngành khó hiểu
items.explanation: jargon /ˈdʒɑː.ɡən/ (danh từ): thuật ngữ chuyên ngành khó hiểu. "Technical jargon" = biệt ngữ kỹ thuật mà người ngoài ngành khó hiểu.
items.explanationEn: jargon /ˈdʒɑː.ɡən/ (noun): specialist words outsiders miss. "Technical jargon" is language that people outside the field struggle to understand.

items.question: Trong câu "Why this format works: it forces you to state the starting state, the action, and the expected result — precisely the three things an under-specified requirement usually omits.", từ "omit" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Why this format works: it forces you to state the starting state, the action, and the expected result — precisely the three things an under-specified requirement usually omits.", what does "omit" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: omit /əˈmɪt/ (động từ): bỏ sót, lược bỏ. Danh từ "omission" = sự bỏ sót, ví dụ "errors and omissions".
items.explanationEn: omit /əˈmɪt/ (verb): to leave out. The noun is "omission", as in "errors and omissions".

items.question: Trong câu "Without it, "done" becomes an elastic concept.", từ "elastic" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Without it, "done" becomes an elastic concept.", what does "elastic" (adjective) mean?
options: co giãn, dễ bị hiểu khác nhau
items.explanation: elastic /iˈlæs.tɪk/ (tính từ): co giãn, dễ bị hiểu khác nhau. "An elastic concept" = khái niệm co giãn, mỗi người hiểu một kiểu; trong cloud "elastic" = tự co giãn tài nguyên.
items.explanationEn: elastic /iˈlæs.tɪk/ (adjective): stretchable in meaning. "An elastic concept" means different things to different people; in cloud, elastic means scaling up and down.

items.question: Trong câu "The consequence: velocity becomes meaningless and hidden "completion debt" accumulates silently.", từ "accumulate" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The consequence: velocity becomes meaningless and hidden "completion debt" accumulates silently.", what does "accumulate" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: accumulate /əˈkjuː.mjə.leɪt/ (động từ): tích tụ, dồn lại. "Debt accumulates" = nợ (kỹ thuật) tích tụ dần; danh từ "accumulation".
items.explanationEn: accumulate /əˈkjuː.mjə.leɪt/ (verb): to build up over time. "Debt accumulates" means it builds up over time; the noun is "accumulation".

items.question: Trong câu "The team believes it finished 10 stories while weeks of testing and defect-fixing work still lurk behind them.", từ "lurk" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The team believes it finished 10 stories while weeks of testing and defect-fixing work still lurk behind them.", what does "lurk" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: lurk /lɜːk/ (động từ): ẩn nấp, tiềm ẩn. "Lurk" gợi ý điều gì đó nguy hiểm ẩn giấu, ví dụ "bugs lurking in the code".
items.explanationEn: lurk /lɜːk/ (verb): to stay hidden, waiting. It suggests a hidden danger, as in "bugs lurking in the code".

items.question: Trong câu "This is one of the most common reasons agile projects slip without anyone noticing until it is too late.", từ "slip" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "This is one of the most common reasons agile projects slip without anyone noticing until it is too late.", what does "slip" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: slip /slɪp/ (động từ): bị trễ tiến độ. "The deadline / schedule slips" = hạn chót bị lùi, dự án trễ; nghĩa đen là trượt chân.
items.explanationEn: slip /slɪp/ (verb): to fall behind schedule. "The schedule slips" means work falls behind; the literal sense is sliding and falling.

items.question: Trong câu "This is agile most notorious weak spot when practised carelessly.", từ "notorious" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "This is agile most notorious weak spot when practised carelessly.", what does "notorious" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: notorious /nəʊˈtɔː.ri.əs/ (tính từ): khét tiếng (theo nghĩa xấu). "Notorious for something" = khét tiếng vì điều gì tệ; khác với "famous" mang nghĩa trung tính/tốt.
items.explanationEn: notorious /nəʊˈtɔː.ri.əs/ (adjective): famous for something bad. "Notorious for something" means well known for something bad, unlike neutral "famous".

items.question: Trong câu "Quality attributes like security, scalability, and maintainability are invisible and belong to no single story — they span the whole product.", từ "span" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Quality attributes like security, scalability, and maintainability are invisible and belong to no single story — they span the whole product.", what does "span" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: span /spæn/ (động từ): trải rộng khắp. "Span the whole product / several teams" = trải khắp toàn bộ sản phẩm, nhiều nhóm.
items.explanationEn: span /spæn/ (verb): to extend across. Common uses are "span the whole product" and "span several teams".

items.question: Trong câu "Fold them into the acceptance criteria of a related story.", từ "fold into" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Fold them into the acceptance criteria of a related story.", what does "fold into" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: fold into /fəʊld ˈɪn.tuː/ (cụm từ): lồng ghép vào, gộp vào. "Fold X into Y" = gộp X vào Y; "fold" đơn lẻ còn nghĩa gấp (giấy) hoặc (công ty) đóng cửa.
items.explanationEn: fold into /fəʊld ˈɪn.tuː/ (phrase): to merge into. "Fold X into Y" means merging X into Y; alone, "fold" can mean bending paper or a business closing.

items.question: Trong câu "When a quality attribute demands substantial architectural work — building a caching tier, setting up monitoring infrastructure — create a separate story and put it in the backlog.", từ "substantial" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "When a quality attribute demands substantial architectural work — building a caching tier, setting up monitoring infrastructure — create a separate story and put it in the backlog.", what does "substantial" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: substantial /səbˈstæn.ʃəl/ (tính từ): đáng kể, nhiều. "Substantial work / effort / changes" = khối lượng công việc, thay đổi đáng kể.
items.explanationEn: substantial /səbˈstæn.ʃəl/ (adjective): large in amount. Typical collocations are "substantial work", "substantial effort" and "substantial changes".

items.question: Trong câu "A note about enabler stories: they violate the V in INVEST because they deliver no direct user value.", từ "violate" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A note about enabler stories: they violate the V in INVEST because they deliver no direct user value.", what does "violate" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: violate /ˈvaɪə.leɪt/ (động từ): vi phạm. "Violate a rule / constraint / principle" = vi phạm quy tắc, ràng buộc, nguyên tắc.
items.explanationEn: violate /ˈvaɪə.leɪt/ (verb): to break a rule. It collocates with "a rule", "a constraint" or "a principle".

items.question: Trong câu "That is acceptable and sometimes necessary — but use them selectively, and always state which user-facing story they enable.", từ "selectively" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "That is acceptable and sometimes necessary — but use them selectively, and always state which user-facing story they enable.", what does "selectively" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: selectively /sɪˈlek.tɪv.li/ (trạng từ): có chọn lọc. "Use something selectively" = chỉ dùng khi thật sự phù hợp, có cân nhắc.
items.explanationEn: selectively /sɪˈlek.tɪv.li/ (adverb): only when well chosen. "Use something selectively" means only in carefully chosen cases.

items.question: Trong câu "If in iteration ten you learn the system must support 10,000 concurrent users, or must run on mobile, or must comply with a data regulation, retrofitting could force much of the completed work to be redone.", từ "concurrent" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "If in iteration ten you learn the system must support 10,000 concurrent users, or must run on mobile, or must comply with a data regulation, retrofitting could force much of the completed work to be redone.", what does "concurrent" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: concurrent /kənˈkʌr.ənt/ (tính từ): đồng thời, cùng lúc. "Concurrent users / requests" = người dùng, yêu cầu truy cập cùng một lúc; khác "consecutive" (liên tiếp).
items.explanationEn: concurrent /kənˈkʌr.ənt/ (adjective): at the same time. "Concurrent users" access the system at the same moment; compare "consecutive", one after another.

items.question: Trong câu "retrofitting could force much of the completed work to be redone", từ "retrofit" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "retrofitting could force much of the completed work to be redone", what does "retrofit" (verb) mean?
options: bổ sung vào cái đã có sẵn
optionsEn: to add to something already built
items.explanation: retrofit /ˈret.rəʊ.fɪt/ (động từ): bổ sung vào cái đã có sẵn. "Retrofit security / accessibility" = gắn thêm bảo mật, khả năng truy cập vào hệ thống đã xây xong, thường tốn kém.
items.explanationEn: retrofit /ˈret.rəʊ.fɪt/ (verb): to add to something already built. "Retrofit security" means adding it to an existing system, which is usually costly.

items.question: Trong câu "Reserve a fixed share of capacity for technical work — many teams reserve 15–20 percent of each iteration for technical debt and architectural work.", từ "reserve" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Reserve a fixed share of capacity for technical work — many teams reserve 15–20 percent of each iteration for technical debt and architectural work.", what does "reserve" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to book a seat or room
to set aside for a purpose
items.explanation: reserve /rɪˈzɜːv/ (động từ): dành riêng, giữ lại. "Reserve capacity for X" = dành sẵn năng lực cho X; nghĩa khác là đặt chỗ trước.
items.explanationEn: reserve /rɪˈzɜːv/ (verb): to set aside for a purpose. "Reserve capacity for X" means setting it aside; another sense is booking a seat or room.

items.question: Trong câu "Does this knowledge need to outlive the team memory?", từ "outlive" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Does this knowledge need to outlive the team memory?", what does "outlive" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: outlive /ˌaʊtˈlɪv/ (động từ): tồn tại lâu hơn. "Outlive something" = sống, tồn tại lâu hơn cái gì; tiền tố "out-" mang nghĩa vượt hơn.
items.explanationEn: outlive /ˌaʊtˈlɪv/ (verb): to last longer than. "Outlive something" means lasting beyond it; the prefix "out-" means "more than".

items.question: Trong câu "In regulated domains, documentation is legally mandatory regardless of your method.", từ "mandatory" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "In regulated domains, documentation is legally mandatory regardless of your method.", what does "mandatory" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: mandatory /ˈmæn.də.tər.i/ (tính từ): bắt buộc. "Mandatory field / training" = trường, khóa đào tạo bắt buộc; trái nghĩa "optional".
items.explanationEn: mandatory /ˈmæn.də.tər.i/ (adjective): required by rule. Examples are "a mandatory field" and "mandatory training"; the opposite is "optional".

items.question: Trong câu "Where face-to-face communication is unavailable, documentation has to compensate.", từ "compensate" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Where face-to-face communication is unavailable, documentation has to compensate.", what does "compensate" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to pay money for a loss
to make up for a lack
items.explanation: compensate /ˈkɒm.pən.seɪt/ (động từ): bù đắp. "Compensate for something" = bù đắp cho sự thiếu hụt; nghĩa khác là bồi thường (tiền).
items.explanationEn: compensate /ˈkɒm.pən.seɪt/ (verb): to make up for a lack. "Compensate for something" means making up for a lack; another sense is paying for a loss.

items.question: Trong câu "Architectural decisions and their rationale — future maintainers will thank you.", từ "rationale" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Architectural decisions and their rationale — future maintainers will thank you.", what does "rationale" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: rationale /ˌræʃ.əˈnɑːl/ (danh từ): lý do căn bản. "The rationale for / behind a decision" = lý do đứng sau quyết định; ghi lại nó giúp người bảo trì sau này.
items.explanationEn: rationale /ˌræʃ.əˈnɑːl/ (noun): the reasons behind something. "The rationale behind a decision" explains why it was made, which helps future maintainers.

items.question: Trong câu "Automated acceptance tests — the only documentation that never goes stale, because it runs.", từ "go stale" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Automated acceptance tests — the only documentation that never goes stale, because it runs.", what does "go stale" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: go stale /ɡəʊ steɪl/ (cụm từ): trở nên lỗi thời. "Documentation goes stale" = tài liệu trở nên lỗi thời, không khớp với hệ thống; nghĩa đen là ôi, cũ (bánh mì).
items.explanationEn: go stale /ɡəʊ steɪl/ (phrase): to become out of date. "Documentation goes stale" when it no longer matches the system; literally, bread goes stale.

items.question: Trong câu "One last thought worth sitting with: if your team discards user stories after implementation, then the automated acceptance tests may be the ONLY durable documentation of what the system does.", từ "durable" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "One last thought worth sitting with: if your team discards user stories after implementation, then the automated acceptance tests may be the ONLY durable documentation of what the system does.", what does "durable" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: durable /ˈdjʊə.rə.bəl/ (tính từ): bền vững, tồn tại lâu. "Durable documentation / storage" = tài liệu, lưu trữ bền lâu; danh từ "durability".
items.explanationEn: durable /ˈdjʊə.rə.bəl/ (adjective): long-lasting. It appears in "durable documentation" and "durable storage"; the noun is "durability".

items.question: Trong câu "Change still has an opportunity cost.", từ "opportunity cost" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Change still has an opportunity cost.", what does "opportunity cost" (phrase) mean?
optionsEn: a cost that stays the same
the value of the option given up
items.explanation: opportunity cost /ˌɒp.əˈtʃuː.nə.ti kɒst/ (cụm từ): chi phí cơ hội. "Opportunity cost" = giá trị của lựa chọn bị bỏ qua khi chọn phương án khác.
items.explanationEn: opportunity cost /ˌɒp.əˈtʃuː.nə.ti kɒst/ (phrase): the value of the option given up. It is the value of the best alternative you give up when you choose something else.

items.question: Trong câu "There is no free lunch — only more transparency about what you are trading away.", từ "no free lunch" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "There is no free lunch — only more transparency about what you are trading away.", what does "no free lunch" (phrase) mean?
options: không có gì miễn phí cả
items.explanation: no free lunch /nəʊ friː lʌntʃ/ (cụm từ): không có gì miễn phí cả. Thành ngữ "there is no such thing as a free lunch" = cái gì cũng có cái giá của nó.
items.explanationEn: no free lunch /nəʊ friː lʌntʃ/ (phrase): nothing comes without a cost. It comes from "there is no such thing as a free lunch": every benefit has a cost.

items.question: Trong câu "Agile reduces this cost by shortening the feedback loop, not by eliminating it.", từ "feedback loop" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Agile reduces this cost by shortening the feedback loop, not by eliminating it.", what does "feedback loop" (phrase) mean?
optionsEn: the cycle of acting and learning
items.explanation: feedback loop /ˈfiːd.bæk luːp/ (cụm từ): vòng phản hồi. "Shorten the feedback loop" = rút ngắn thời gian từ lúc làm đến lúc nhận phản hồi.
items.explanationEn: feedback loop /ˈfiːd.bæk luːp/ (phrase): the cycle of acting and learning. "Shorten the feedback loop" means getting a response to your work sooner.

items.question: Trong câu "The consequence: knowledge evaporates as people leave the team, and future maintainers do not understand why the system was built as it was.", từ "evaporate" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The consequence: knowledge evaporates as people leave the team, and future maintainers do not understand why the system was built as it was.", what does "evaporate" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to turn from liquid to gas
items.explanation: evaporate /ɪˈvæp.ə.reɪt/ (động từ): tan biến, mất dần. Nghĩa bóng "knowledge / support evaporates" = tri thức, sự ủng hộ mất dần; nghĩa đen là bay hơi.
items.explanationEn: evaporate /ɪˈvæp.ə.reɪt/ (verb): to fade away. Figuratively "knowledge evaporates" means it disappears; literally water evaporates into gas.

items.question: Trong câu "Destroys your forecasting tool and incentivises estimate inflation.", từ "incentivise" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Destroys your forecasting tool and incentivises estimate inflation.", what does "incentivise" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to give a reason to do
items.explanation: incentivise /ɪnˈsen.tɪ.vaɪz/ (động từ): khuyến khích, tạo động cơ. Anh-Mỹ viết "incentivize"; danh từ "incentive" = động cơ, phần thưởng khuyến khích.
items.explanationEn: incentivise /ɪnˈsen.tɪ.vaɪz/ (verb): to give a reason to do. The American spelling is "incentivize"; the noun "incentive" is a motivating reward.

items.question: Trong câu "Agile is not a set of rituals — it is a set of principles about SHORT FEEDBACK LOOPS and CONTINUOUS ADJUSTMENT.", từ "ritual" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Agile is not a set of rituals — it is a set of principles about SHORT FEEDBACK LOOPS and CONTINUOUS ADJUSTMENT.", what does "ritual" (noun) mean?
options: nghi thức làm theo thói quen
items.explanation: ritual /ˈrɪtʃ.u.əl/ (danh từ): nghi thức làm theo thói quen. Ở đây "rituals" chỉ các cuộc họp, thủ tục làm cho có mà không hiểu mục đích.
items.explanationEn: ritual /ˈrɪtʃ.u.əl/ (noun): a routine done by habit. Here "rituals" means meetings and routines followed by habit without grasping their purpose.

items.question: Trong câu "With these four present, most other details sort themselves out.", từ "sort out" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "With these four present, most other details sort themselves out.", what does "sort out" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: sort out /sɔːt aʊt/ (cụm từ): được giải quyết ổn thỏa. "Things sort themselves out" = mọi việc tự ổn thỏa; "sort" đơn lẻ còn là sắp xếp.
items.explanationEn: sort out /sɔːt aʊt/ (phrase): to get resolved. "Things sort themselves out" means they get resolved naturally; "sort" alone means to put in order.

items.question: Trong câu "You just do it at a smaller scale, more often, and with less ceremony.", từ "ceremony" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "You just do it at a smaller scale, more often, and with less ceremony.", what does "ceremony" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: ceremony /ˈser.ɪ.mə.ni/ (danh từ): thủ tục hình thức. "With less ceremony" = ít thủ tục hình thức hơn; nghĩa gốc là buổi lễ.
items.explanationEn: ceremony /ˈser.ɪ.mə.ni/ (noun): formal procedure. "With less ceremony" means with fewer formalities; the basic sense is a formal event.

items.question: Trong câu "An important warning indicator: if the requirements change rate is NOT decreasing over time, the project is in trouble.", từ "in trouble" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "An important warning indicator: if the requirements change rate is NOT decreasing over time, the project is in trouble.", what does "in trouble" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: in trouble /ɪn ˈtrʌb.əl/ (cụm từ): gặp rắc rối. "Be in trouble" = đang gặp rắc rối nghiêm trọng; "get into trouble" = gặp rắc rối.
items.explanationEn: in trouble /ɪn ˈtrʌb.əl/ (phrase): facing serious problems. "Be in trouble" means facing serious problems; "get into trouble" is the related phrase.

items.question: Trong câu "The product backlog is ordered by value and refined continuously through grooming, with a definition of ready protecting the team.", từ "refine" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The product backlog is ordered by value and refined continuously through grooming, with a definition of ready protecting the team.", what does "refine" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: refine /rɪˈfaɪn/ (động từ): tinh chỉnh, làm rõ dần. "Refine the backlog" = làm rõ, chia nhỏ các mục; danh từ "refinement".
items.explanationEn: refine /rɪˈfaɪn/ (verb): to improve by adding detail. "Refine the backlog" means clarifying and splitting items; the noun is "refinement".

items.question: Trong câu "A user story is a reminder of a conversation, confirmed by acceptance criteria and judged against INVEST.", từ "confirm" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A user story is a reminder of a conversation, confirmed by acceptance criteria and judged against INVEST.", what does "confirm" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: confirm /kənˈfɜːm/ (động từ): xác nhận. Danh từ "confirmation" chính là chữ C thứ ba trong mô hình 3C.
items.explanationEn: confirm /kənˈfɜːm/ (verb): to show to be true. The noun "confirmation" is the third C in the three Cs model.

items.question: Trong câu "Story mapping supplies the structure a flat backlog lacks, letting you slice releases along a complete workflow.", từ "supply" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Story mapping supplies the structure a flat backlog lacks, letting you slice releases along a complete workflow.", what does "supply" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: supply /səˈplaɪ/ (động từ): cung cấp. "Supply what X lacks" = cung cấp thứ X còn thiếu; danh từ "supply" = nguồn cung.
items.explanationEn: supply /səˈplaɪ/ (verb): to provide. "Supply what X lacks" means providing the missing part; as a noun, "supply" is a stock.

items.question: Trong câu "Story mapping exposes gaps a flat list never reveals.", từ "reveal" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Story mapping exposes gaps a flat list never reveals.", what does "reveal" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: reveal /rɪˈviːl/ (động từ): tiết lộ, cho thấy. "Reveal a gap / problem" = cho thấy thiếu sót; gần nghĩa với "expose", "uncover".
items.explanationEn: reveal /rɪˈviːl/ (verb): to make visible. "Reveal a gap" is close in meaning to "expose" or "uncover".

items.question: Trong câu "Relative estimation plus velocity gives honest forecasts — as long as you do not abuse them as performance metrics.", từ "abuse" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Relative estimation plus velocity gives honest forecasts — as long as you do not abuse them as performance metrics.", what does "abuse" (verb) mean?
options: lạm dụng, dùng sai mục đích
optionsEn: to misuse for a wrong purpose
items.explanation: abuse /əˈbjuːz/ (động từ): lạm dụng, dùng sai mục đích. "Abuse a metric" = dùng chỉ số sai mục đích; nghĩa khác là ngược đãi người khác.
items.explanationEn: abuse /əˈbjuːz/ (verb): to misuse for a wrong purpose. "Abuse a metric" means using it for the wrong purpose; another sense is treating someone cruelly.
